verdict.rationale: Kushki claims 'multiple payment methods with one API' and documents Webpay Plus, a Chilean redirect-based local payment method, so it offers some local-method acceptance alongside cards. Nothing in the evidence shows Apple Pay, Google Pay, or BNPL. missing for 10: Apple Pay/Google Pay wallet support, BNPL options, documented bank-transfer redirects beyond Webpay Plus, proof these methods work through a single integration, independent corroboration.
